title: Compact exact stats-once reduction-transport physical calibration
hypothesis: A compact-pin physical harness containing the exact c16/r2/l8/b59 global tree, real stats-once reduction codecs, endpoint adapters, 4x4 mesh, shared-root storage, and the admission boundary can establish a reusable Nangate45 reduction-transport/fabric PPA anchor without treating verification stimulus as DUT area.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What are the timing, area, and whole-harness power bounds of the exact 15-source, 15-bank shared-root reduction-transport composition under a conservative hierarchical physical canary?
include: 35 input bits and 128 output bits at the compact physical boundary
15 exact stats-once source encoders and packet adapters
real 4x4 deterministic-XY mesh and shared-root receive/storage path
a small Nangate45 clock and placement-density canary sweep
exclude: HBM/DRAM controller and off-chip memory service
claiming verification stimulus logic as DUT area
claiming whole-harness vectorless power as workload activity energy
the separate 112 shared-SRAM stream contexts and their packet traffic
reinstating any retracted L2 Phase-2 schedule, frontier, or finite-endpoint result
Llama7B quality claims; those require the separate exact MHA quality gate

required_evaluations.objective: Measure the compact exact stats-once reduction-transport composition with the exact global tree and 15-bank fakeram root storage.

expected_result.reason: Use physical evidence to replace reduction-transport and shared-root fabric abstractions before composing shared-SRAM traffic and recosting the Llama7B schedule.

required_evaluations.acceptance_notes: Require the generated top/guard to prove 35 input bits, 128 output bits, composition/exact_transport_wrapper/ hierarchy, exact c16/r2/l8/b59 tree, PHYSICAL_BANKS=15, USE_FAKERAM=1, and exactly 120 fakeram45_64x32 macros. Attach hierarchical area to metrics.csv after each successful OpenROAD result. Treat this as reduction-traffic evidence only, treat total_power_mw as a whole-harness upper bound, and do not restore retracted L2 frontier artifacts. Preserve v1 as an invalid-configuration failure before synthesis, not physical infeasibility.

revision.replacement_contract: SYNTH_HIERARCHICAL retains the elaborated hierarchy without selecting vanished pre-elaboration module names

required_evaluations.objective: Compare flat and hierarchy-preserving Yosys synthesis of the exact shared-root transport while retaining fakeram blackboxes and excluding macro Liberty from synthesis.

expected_result.reason: Choose a bounded physical-flow decomposition from measured synthesis success, elapsed time, failure signature, and resource behavior rather than repeating the 17 GiB r2 path.

required_evaluations.acceptance_notes: This is a synth-only legality/resource diagnostic, not PPA evidence. Preserve both successful and failed mode rows. Keep all 120 fakeram45_64x32 instances as blackboxes, pass ADDITIONAL_LIBS= during synthesis, and do not run hierarchy-area or timing postchecks. The v1 paramod-selection failure and r2 resource-boundary failure remain explicit history.

revision.reason: r2 passed parameter elaboration but both physical points reached roughly 17 GiB RSS and flow_failed during hierarchy synthesis
revision.replacement_contract: Unique flat/hierarchical synth-only flow variants with fakeram blackboxes and no macro Liberty

remaining_abstractions: The 112 shared-SRAM stream contexts and their packet traffic are not composed in this reduction-transport item.
Whole-harness power is an upper bound until workload activity power is separately measured.
This canary does not by itself establish exact Llama7B MHA quality or final token throughput.
